blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — The United States announced tougher export control measures on AI chips Monday, after a scandal ensnaring Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang exposed a loophole allegedly exploited by Chinese companies. The news came the day before Californian chip titan Nvidia reports its first earnings since Huang’s departure as CEO, with investors questioning if […]...
